newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATTELEKOM GETS 12MLN LAT SYNDICATED LOAN. [CORRECTED 15:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: LATTELEKOM GETS 12MLN LAT SYNDICATED LOAN. [CORRECTED 15:30 GMT]

text.p: Parekss Bank and Hansabank Latvia said on Friday that they had granted a 12 million lat syndicated loan to Lattelekom.
"The loan maturity is two years with an interest rate corresponding to the Latvian government's six-month Treasury bill rate plus two percent," the banks and Lattelkom said in a joint statement.
The statement also said that the loan was meant for refinancing a loan taken by Lattelekom from a foreign bank.
Apart from Parekss and Hansabank Latvia, funds for the syndicated loan were also provided by the Latvia's Investment Bank and Estonia's Hansabank.
Parekss Bank will act as the paying agent (corrects from lead manager) of the loan, the statement said.
"This is the biggest ever syndicated loan in the national currency lat prepared by Latvia's banks," the statement said.
"It can be considered a serious step in the delopment of co-operation between banks and businesses in Latvia."
Lattlekom is co-owned by Britain's Cable and Wireless and Finland's telecom company. It has a monopoly on Latvia's telecommunications market.
